product_metadata.title: DEXI Bathroom Rug Mat, Extra Soft and Absorbent Bath Rugs, Washable Non-Slip Carpet Mat for Bathroom Floor, Tub, Shower Room (43"x24", Navy)
features: SOFT PLUSH- This bath mat is shaggy and super soft, 100% microfiber brings you a comfortable feeling to the touch for your feet.
ULTRA ABSORBENT-The plush bathroom mat features ultra water absorbing. The thick and high fluffy absorbs water quickly and protect your floor from dripping water.

NON-SLIP- The backing of non-slip bath rug is made of TPR rubber material with geometric design. The anti slip bath mat will keep firmly in place, it's more safe and cozy. Please place bathroom rug on dry smooth floor.

WASHABLE & DURABLE- DEXI bath carpet is easy to clean, no shedding and is fade resistant. Just wash it as often as needed and our bathroom floor mat looks like new after washing and is durable for long lasting use.

MULTI-PURPOSE- Our bathroom rugs are widely used for bedroom, bathroom, living room, hotel, feet-spa club, etc. In addition, if you have any problem with products, please contact us, we will reply for you in the first time.
